IonQ has released a comprehensive, end‑to‑end fault‑tolerant resource estimate for executing Shor’s algorithm on 256‑bit elliptic‑curve cryptographic keys. The report quantifies the required logical qubits, physical qubits under surface-code error correction, circuit depth, and runtime to factor such keys, highlighting both the feasibility and practical challenges of quantum attacks at this security level. These findings provide a benchmark for future quantum processors and guidance for post‑quantum cryptography planning.
